title: Topological sort

hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 40 min Coding Deep dive Graphs

Topological sort: ordering things that depend on each other

Whenever a problem says "A must happen before B", you are holding a directed graph, and the question is almost always one of three: is there a valid order, what is one, or how many rounds does it take. This page builds both standard algorithms (Kahn's in-degree queue and DFS with three colours) from scratch, uses them to solve Course Schedule I and II, derives the letter order in Alien Dictionary, counts semesters in Parallel Courses, and ends with the variants interviewers use to push SDE-2 and SDE-3 candidates.
